page: Google Cloud Platform ct5lp-hightpu-8t is a TPU-accelerated server instance designed for machine learning workloads. It features an x86_64 CPU architecture with 224 dedicated vCPUs and 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 1.71 GB of RAM per core. The instance does not include local storage or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The primary acceleration is delivered by eight integrated Google TPU v5e chips, providing a total of 128 GB of VRAM. This hardware configuration is optimized for matrix multiplication operations and tensor processing. Because there is no local storage bundled with this instance, storage must be provisioned externally, which represents a key architectural tradeoff for data-heavy pipelines.

This instance is designed for distributed machine learning training, large-scale transformer model inference, and deep learning workloads. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the high density of dedicated vCPUs paired with eight TPU v5e accelerators offers a specialized hardware profile that reduces the resource overhead typically associated with general-purpose compute instances when running tensor-intensive operations.
